row.notes: Under global lock 0x146cea6a8, turns the four wheel damage floats +0x130..+0x13c into a 3-bit state per wheel (shifts 0, 3, 6, 9) and returns the OR. Thresholds are XOR-obfuscated floats: T1 = +0x58 ^ +0x60, T2 = +0x68 ^ +0x70. State 5 if damage >= 2*T2, 4 if >= T2, 3 if >= T1, else 2 or 1 from bits 0/1 of the wheel flag byte (car +8 -> +0x580 -> +0x70/+0x78/+0x80/+0x88 -> +0x20), else 0. Good read point for suspension damage levels; the thresholds are the tuning values.
